newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar ends barely up in very slim trade.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar ends barely up in very slim trade.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures drifted into the weekend slightly firmer, but gains were limited to a narrow six-point trading range.
Volume was estimated at only 3,939 lots.
The most-active contract finished up 0.04 at 10.70, having ranged from 10.71 to 10.65. The deferred months closed flat to 0.01 lower.
Resistance remained at 10.80 and support at 10.50 in March, with the market seen trending lower on abundant world supplies.
In fundamental news, Brazil said it will maintain its sugar exports at 5.0 million tonnes a year. Brazil produces about 14 million tonnes of cane sugar annually.
Industry sources said many traders were absent from the market due to the London Sugar Market annual dinner.
